scope: Author packets/self-checks describe author-stage content. Independent review corrections are subsequent evidence and do not relabel the author checks as final checks.

newline_reconstruction.applies_to: The after_sha256 bytes in the named source-freeze commit, before independent editorial/content corrections.
newline_reconstruction.method: Read each source at the pinned source-freeze commit, verify its after_sha256, then replace LF with CRLF and verify before_sha256. Do not apply the reconstruction to a later edited working copy.

final_binding_rule: Final independent review, source bindings and authoritative test-run receipts identify the corrected publication bytes. Original failed attempts and superseded author evidence remain historical.
